title: Principal, Teacher, Warden, Accountant, Lab Assistant, Peon, Watchman, and Cook Posts
application_fee: No application fee specified, but 2 self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 56-56 stamps required.
age_limit: For Principal: 30-45 years as of 01.04.2026. For other posts: 25-45 years as of 01.04.2026. Maximum age limit is 60 years for service in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya.
summary: The District Basic Education Office Lakhimpur has invited offline applications from eligible female candidates for various academic and non-academic positions on a contractual basis in Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas for the academic session 2026-27. Interested candidates must submit their filled applications with self-attested documents via registered/speed post by 30.11.2026.
eligibility_bullets: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for all posts.
Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from 8th pass to Post Graduation with B.Ed. and relevant training.
Age limits: 30-45 years for Principal and 25-45 years for other posts as of 01.04.2026.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format and details from the official website www.kheri.nic.in.
Fill out the application completely and attach self-attested copies of all required educational and supporting documents.
Include 2 self-addressed envelopes affixed with Rs. 56-56 postal stamps inside the application packet.

Send the completed application by Registered / Speed Post to the Office of District Basic Education Officer, Samagra Shiksha, District Lakhimpur Kheri, Pin Code-262701 latest by 30.11.2026 up to 05:00 PM.
